subject.title: [Feature]: Automatically install brew if not installed

question: Should OpenClaw skill setup ever execute a Homebrew bootstrapper when brew is missing, and if so under what explicit-consent, source-verification, and platform policy?
rationale: The requested behavior changes displayed setup guidance into execution of external package-manager bootstrap code, which affects security posture and first-run UX beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Manual Default
options.body: Preserve the current behavior of showing or grouping manual Homebrew prerequisites while improving wording only where needed.

options.title: Add Explicit Bootstrap
options.body: Allow Homebrew installation only after a clear opt-in prompt with approved source, platform/container rules, logging, timeout, and failure handling.

options.title: Prefer Native Alternatives
options.body: Avoid Homebrew bootstrap and instead improve skill metadata, native package fallbacks, or ClawHub/plugin guidance for affected skills.

recommendation.title: Keep Manual Default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current behavior of showing or grouping manual Homebrew prerequisites while improving wording only where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to steipete for Homebrew onboarding policy, Linuxbrew behavior, and the current published docs stance.
